versions.content: If a DTC is configured with DemNvStorageStrategy = DUR- ING_SHUTDOWN , any change of its data (DTC, UDS status, event memory entry) shall only be stored to NvM during shutdown.
If a DTC is configured with DemNvStorageStrategy = DUR- ING_SHUTDOWN , any change of its data (DTC, UDS status, event memory entry) shall only be stored to NvM during shutdown.

Storage of event related data at shutdown If a DTC is con- figured with DemNvStorageStrategy = DURING_SHUTDOWN or DemNvStorageS- trategy is not configured, the Dem shall trigger the storage of the event related data to NvM only during shutdown. (refer to [SWS_Dem_00341])
